description: This file contains SASS/LESS mixins for Font Awesome icon styling, including transformations, accessibility helpers, and utility classes.

methods.name: fa-icon
methods.description: Defines styling for icons including font properties and smoothing options.

methods.name: fa-icon-rotate
methods.description: Applies rotation transformation to icons based on specified degrees and rotation values.

methods.name: fa-icon-flip
methods.description: Applies scale transformations to flip icons horizontally or vertically with optional rotation.

methods.name: sr-only
methods.description: Provides styles to visually hide content but keep it accessible to screen readers.

methods.name: sr-only-focusable
methods.description: Allows hidden content to become visible when focused or active, enhancing accessibility.
